propositions: A plan attestation with declared file_impact_scope: none should remain valid after unrelated commits, bypassing whole-HEAD code freshness checks while preserving other validity dimensions
The manifest signing flow must classify file scope into three states (paths, none, unscoped) based on dependency map and declared scope, emitting file-scope: none only when explicitly signed
An authenticated none-scoped manifest must be distinguishable from undeclared empty impact; plaintext-only declarations cannot suppress stale-head verdict
Material fingerprint for none-scoped records must include a canonical JSON basis member capturing file_impact_scope and reason, making scope or reason edits after signing produce stale-material
Recovery re-sign via resign_plan_review must preserve the effective none scope through the same signing boundary without new branches
Legacy attestations with empty dependencies and unscoped manifest must retain whole-HEAD freshness semantics, returning stale-head after HEAD moves
